item.description: The reopening, which began on February 14, 2026, does not introduce a new product.

item.title: Yango taps Flutterwave for cashless taxi, food delivery payments in Zambia
item.description: Yango users in Zambia can now use cards to pay for their rides and food delivery orders after Flutterwave partnership.

item.title: He learned trade from his mother. Now he’s building a pan-African marketplace.
item.description: Chima now applies those early lessons in trade to Kuraway, a business-to-business (B2B) platform that serves as a digital intermediary for suppliers and retailers across the continent.

item.title: Kenyan SME lender 4G Capital says 92% of borrowers repay on time as bad loans rise
item.description: 4G Capital says it has disbursed $889 million through 6.8 million loans to more than 723,000 customers in Kenya and Uganda.

item.title: After TechCabal report, JAMB promises audio texts for blind candidates, registration fee refunds
item.description: JAMB has said visually impaired candidates who paid for the ongoing UTME registration will be refunded at the point of examination, and audio versions of prescribed texts will be provided after registration closes.

item.title: In 2025, four in five smartphones sold in Africa cost under $200
item.description: Africa recorded 84.4 million smartphone shipments in 2025, a 13% year-on-year increase, Omdia said. Devices priced below $200 accounted for 81% of total shipments.

item.title: South Africa plans incentives as data centres gain “critical” status
item.description: Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana said the government now views data infrastructure as essential to the economy, comparing it to electricity, ports, and transport networks.
